depictions.name: Temple of Athena Chalkioikos
depictions.text: Temple of Athena The Temple of Athena Chalkioikos was a temple complex dedicated to the goddess Athena located on the acropolis of Sparta in Lakonia, Greece. One of Sparta's most important monuments, the bronze sheets that covered its interior gave birth to the name Chalkioikos (Bronze House). In the late 5th century BCE, the temple was visited by the Spartan misthios Kassandra.
